mechanism: Gentamicin's nephrotoxicity may impair renal clearance of galantamine, increasing galantamine exposure and cholinergic effects; additive risks of syncope and bradycardia via cholinergic effects.
action: Monitor renal function closely, assess for cholinergic toxicity symptoms (bradycardia, syncope, muscle weakness), and consider dose adjustment of galantamine if renal impairment develops during gentamicin therapy.
